---
name: why
description: Investigate design rationale, regression history, or the evidence behind a code decision.
---

Before following this skill, read [efficiency](../../docs/efficiency.md) and [the host runtime](../../docs/runtime.md) once per workflow context. Their host and routing rules supersede the inherited instructions below.

# Why

Anchor the question to relevant code and tests. Search targeted git history and linked PRs or issues when available. Follow evidence to another source only when it can answer a remaining question; do not search every connected system by default. Use current host tools and authorized access.

Separate documented facts, supported inferences, and unknowns. Cite the evidence actually read. An absent paper trail does not prove intent. For a requested exhaustive audit, cover the requested categories and identify missing access explicitly.

Work directly by default. Use [swarm](../swarm/SKILL.md) for independent evidence questions only when justified by its budget and startup cost. The lead synthesizes findings. When this precedes a change, summarize the constraints to preserve and the remaining uncertainty.
